X is an insoluble binary compound.
In an experiment, X is electrolysed to form two elements.
Which statement describes X?
A
X is a molten ionic compound.
B
X is an aqueous ionic compound.
C
X is a molten covalent compound.
D
X is a solid covalent compound.
